branch_taken: v0.58.0 RELEASED (all 9 gated pass): the frozen certify/32b at B61 24M decided 6/6 fresh 24-state 4-bit worlds [0.61, 1.00], WRONG 0/8; one needed 15.1M conflicts; in the 061 probe two hard 060 seeds stayed IDU at 24M and 32 states decided 0/2. Budget keeps buying 4-bit decisions at 24 states at rising cost, but it has never moved 2-bit readings (058: B2 0/12, B2R 0/12 at 2M). Plan 062 therefore returns to the Open problem with a policy step (probe-word windows), keeping B2 as the budget-matched control.

choice.window_policy: CHOSEN (gated headline). A new action policy, certify/20w: after the passive prefix, every exploration step is followed by one fixed probe word p (length 2, declared below), so each window start state gets a comparable multi-step reading signature of 3 readings x 2 bits = 6 bits. The frozen certify/20b solver at read_bits 2 is used unchanged; only the actions differ.
choice.entropy_actions: REJECTED for this cycle (Inferred). Choosing each action to maximise the predicted reading entropy over the candidate pool mainly buys new coverage and rival disagreement; study 057 already showed that full reachable coverage (COV_O, an oracle) decided 1/12 at 20 states. It stays a candidate if windows fail.
choice.budget_only: REJECTED as the headline (Observed): probe 061 decided the same 2/4 hard 24-state seeds at 16M and 24M; study 058 decided 0/12 2-bit 20-state worlds (B2, B2R) at 2M. More conflicts alone has shown no gain at the margin. Kept as a control: B2 runs at the same B as W2.

why_windows: Study 058 (Exact, GATES_058) is the strongest lever measured so far: the same solver at 20 states decided B4 11/12 vs B2R 0/12, so bits per state, not budget or coverage, is what moved it. A 2-bit world cannot be given wider readings, but a fixed probe word read from many states gives the solver the same kind of evidence: two window starts whose 6-bit signatures differ must be different states (apartness), which grows the clique the frozen encoding already uses (certify/16e Pool16E) and cuts the symmetric search. Inferred, not shown: the windows move the state, so a signature belongs to the window start; nothing about soundness changes because certify/20b accepts any action sequence.
honest_framing: BACK ON THE HARD PROBLEM: 2-bit readings at 20 states, the problem every release since v0.55.0 has left Open. This is a policy change (which actions are taken), not a new solver or encoding. A pass would be the first 2-bit 20-state decisions by this solver under a declared N; it is not 'first decided 20-state world'. The guarantee stays conditional on the declared N (Inferred: a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state) and on noise-free readings.

budget_probe_rule: Before build_authorization_062, an exploratory probe (scripts/probe_062.py, new file) runs B2 and W2 on sealed study-058 seeds 12530001-12530004 at B in {2M, 8M}, 8 workers, capped at 60 min. B62 is the smallest probed B at which W2 decides >= 1/4; if none, B62 = 8M. The probe also sizes the hard kill. Probe results are never evidence for any gate.

design.api: one new module brute/api/certify20w.py (brute.certify/20w): Certifier20W wraps the frozen Certifier20B(read_bits=2, family_bound=20) and changes only propose(): it returns the frozen proposal followed by the probe word p. observe() and result() are the frozen ones, so every trace is a valid certify/20b trace. Host-agnostic: no I/O, threads, subprocess or os. certify20b, certify16e, certify16d and every earlier api file are imported only.
design.probe_word: p = (0, 1) for num_actions 3, declared now (no tuning on any seed). A second word is not tried in this study.
